title: Q2 Financial Closure Period — 25 June to 2 July
body: All reserve movements and payment authorisations above €50k require Head of Claims sign-off during the Q2 financial closure window. Please plan accordingly and submit requests before 24 June.

title: New Cyber Claims Protocol Effective 1 July
body: Updated internal cyber claims handling procedure aligns with DORA requirements. Mandatory training module available in the learning portal. Completion required by 30 June.

title: System Maintenance — Saturday 14 June, 02:00–06:00 CEST
body: Claims management system will be unavailable for planned maintenance. Claims submitted after 23:00 Friday will be queued and processed from 06:00 Saturday.

title: Reserve Threshold Change — Engineering Line
body: Approval threshold for Engineering line reserves increased from €100k to €150k following Board decision. Updated authority matrix published in the Corporate Rules Book.

title: Reminder: Outstanding AML Checks — 12 Claims
body: Compliance team has flagged 12 claims with outstanding AML verification. Handlers assigned must complete checks before 15 June or claims will be escalated to compliance review.

title: Welcome Georg Stein — New KCM for GPG-001
body: Georg Stein joins the Key Case Management team as KCM for the GPG-001 portfolio. He will oversee the 6 active large-loss claims currently under monitoring.

title: Aviation Handlers: Updated Provider Rate Card 2026
body: The approved rate card for aviation expert witnesses and forensic adjusters has been updated for 2026. New rates apply to all provider instructions issued from 1 June.
